title: Port fetch-workflow-refs and the push guard into susi workflow guard
goal: The pre-push sync-before-push and fast-forward checks and the one-round-trip workflow ref fetch run in Rust (susi workflow guard, susi workflow fetch-refs) through std::process::Command, with no sh, bash, coreutils or jq; .githooks/workflow-guard becomes a stub that execs susi; tests pin the Rust behaviour and a Windows test runs with Git's usr/bin off PATH
